name: viralforge
description: ViralForge - Hindi Regional Food Content Automation Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:workers" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/domain && npm run build --workspace=packages/supabase && npm run build --workspace=services/api && npm run build --workspace=services/workers && npm run build --workspace=services/dashboard
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --workspace=services/api" "npm run start --workspace=services/workers" "npm run start --workspace=services/dashboard"
scripts.infra:up: npm run supabase:start && docker compose up -d redis
scripts.infra:down: docker compose down && npm run supabase:stop
